assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a replacement square character portrait for the fantasy strategy game Astrata. Detailed painterly fantasy illustration with natural textures and emerald/gold light consistent with Astrata. Wood grain flows uninterrupted through the face; no skin, no nose, no ears, no eyelashes, no lips, no humanoid facial mask.
